notes.title: v1.14 version update
notes.content: [p]1. All orange equipment has been changed to random attributes, and duplicate equipment drops are now supported.[/p][p]2. Orange equipment drops have been added to Chapter 3 bosses.[/p][p]3. Added equipment synthesis functionality to Wizard NPCs.[/p]

notes.title: v1.12 version update
notes.content: [p]1. Added Shield Cards for Defense, Invincibility, Shield Bash, Shield Charge, Block and Counter.[/p][p]2. Added a large number of special moves and 5-card skill sets.[/p][p]3. Added a new starting relic selection function.[/p][p]4. Added a new three-weapon combo function.[/p][p]5. Adjusted the maximum skill level from 6 to 3, making leveling more noticeable.[/p]

notes.title: v1.11 version update
notes.content: [p]1. New card control mode and new player guide[/p][p]2. Increased drop rates from bosses and treasure chests[/p][p]3. Redesigned skill UI[/p][p]4. Reduced potion price and optimized tooltips[/p][p]5. Frame rate support with three settings options[/p][p]6. Added UI effects for slam attacks[/p][p]7. Shows the maximum possible stats for Witch Contracts[/p][p]8. Implemented continuous randomization of Witch Contracts[/p][p]9. Optimized NPC interaction UI[/p]

notes.title: v1.10 version update
notes.content: [p]1.A second backpack has been added.[/p][p]2.Potions have been redesigned and can now be brought into combat.[/p][p]3.A wizard's hut has been added to towns, activating the ability to equip the Witch Pact set.[/p][p]4.Added more buffs to cooking, including elemental and hit points.[/p][p]5.Monster damage has been increased to balance the benefits of the above features.[/p]

notes.title: v1.9 version update
notes.content: [p]1. Added an Encounter System[/p][p]2. Added multiple weapons for each weapon level[/p][p]3. Redesigned cooking rules to accommodate any combination of ingredients[/p][p]3. Combining dual forward and dual backward skills allows you to pass through monsters and avoid being surrounded[/p]

notes.title: v1.8 version update
notes.content: [p]1. Added a new strength system. When your hand is not good, you can choose to take fewer actions to accumulate strength, which can be used to trigger a stronger skill and attack next time.[/p][p]2. Added a steam achievement system[/p]

notes.title: v1.7 version update
notes.content: [p]1. Implemented cloud archive function[/p][p]2. Optimized the novice guide, removed the guide that is easy to get stuck, and changed it to a guide for fixed mandatory action card use[/p][p]3. Fixed the bug that the backpack icon gets stuck when dragging props[/p][p]4. Some icons opened in the level have animation effects, which are more obvious to indicate clickability[/p][p]5. Reduced the refresh cost of relics[/p][p]6. The use of medicine bottles no longer consumes durability[/p][p]7. Optimized the interaction with NPCs in the main city[/p]

notes.title: Demo 1.12 update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45422640/16a0d0e79ac58b76515b1261f5ca44e8e3dadd31.png"][/img][/p][p]Demo 1.12 update[/p][p] 1. Crystals can refresh relics [/p][p]2. Optimize the buying and selling process, optimize the repair process [/p][p]3. Reconstruct the potion system to support multiple bottle modes [/p][p]4. Add the function of killing monsters to increase weapon proficiency [/p][p]5. Add elite special effects [/p][p]6. All three weapon heavy attack skills have a stun effect [/p][p]7. The skill is changed to the default level 1 but the damage is not increased [/p][p]8. The magic bottle relic is refreshed with gold coins [/p][p]9. The medicine bottle realizes the durability function [/p][p]10. The relics have 6 restrictions removed[/p]

notes.title: Demo optimization update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45422640/8eb52222249ef30bef82566b0b09d743ad48be75.png"][/img][/p][p]1. Change the stun buff to not cover other buffs[/p][p]2. Fix the bug of not playing the hit animation[/p][p]3. Fix the bug of the dropped item tip blocking the UI[/p][p]4. Implement the Goblin Wizard Fire Wall skill[/p][p]5. Implement material merging to achieve the specified number of material drops[/p][p]6. Fix the problem of background music not looping and add blocking and dodging sound effects[/p][p]7. Double-click to put cooking materials[/p][p]8. Double-click the prop tip residual bug fixed[/p][p]9. Fix the bug that the avatar frame does not shrink after zooming in[/p][p]10. Add the main foot to enter the lounge, and the person appears from the left[/p][p]11. Cancel the scroll wheel operation of the forced card, and do not operate the space to pop up the waiting button and forced card[/p][p]12. Fix the bug that two spaces can still perform empty actions[/p]
